how.title: How does it work?
how.1: Write here what you want to see in the image.
how.2: Have a photo of your own? Attach it (the "Attach photo" button).
how.3: The director writes the prompt and makes the images at once. It asks a question only when a detail is missing.
how.4: The images are made by themselves and show up on the right. The director says what to improve - just keep writing.

help.sub: How to use the studio and where everything is.
help.q1: Open a terminal and run img-on. It starts the server and opens this portal.
help.q2: In Studio, tell the director what you want to see. Attach a photo if you have one.
help.q3: The director writes the prompt and makes the images at once. It asks a question only when a detail is missing.
help.q4: Not happy? Just keep writing what to change, or press Director review. Each run is a round.
help.q5: Press Done and save to keep everything in outputs/sessions/.
help.q6: When you finish, run img-off or press Turn off. Memory goes back to zero.
help.resp1: This tool can change faces and make realistic images of people. Use photos only of people who agreed. Do not make images that deceive, harass, sexualize real people or break the law where you live.
help.resp2: You alone are responsible for everything you make with it. The studio runs only on your own machine, under your control. The author does not run it, see it, store it or review it, and has no part in any prompt, photo or image you create, use or share. The author is not liable for any content made with this software, for how it is used, or for any harm, claim or loss that comes from it. By using it you accept this, and you agree to follow the law and the license of every model you download. The software comes "as is", without warranty of any kind (see LICENSE).
